data.one_liner: Tracks and detects native memory leaks in Dart FFI allocations.
data.what_it_does: It records every allocation made through its custom allocators, storing size, type, call stack, and timestamp. You can then assert that all memory has been freed or inspect live allocations programmatically.
use_when: Testing for leaks in unit or integration tests
Diagnosing production memory leaks in debug builds
avoid_when: When you need zero runtime overhead in release builds, although adaptive allocators compile away
strengths: Zero overhead in release builds via adaptive allocators
Simple API with global or zone enable/disable
weaknesses: Only tracks FFI allocations, not Dart heap allocations
